title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in BdThemes Element…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in BdThemes Element Pack Elementor Addons versions up to 10.0.5. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling attackers to inject malicious scripts. The issue affects versions from an unspecified start through 10.0.5.
